**By the end of today:** an AI-programmed survey, skills to review and improve code, and reusable workflows toautomate tables and charts from your own data.

::: {.notes}
~1 minute. Walk the arc, not every session: this morning we use AI to design surveys and to transcribe and quality-check data (DECSU), then program a survey with an AI agent in parallel hands-on sessions: Survey Solutions (DECSU) or SurveyCTO (Dobility); participants pick one. After lunch we use AI skills to review and improve data-processing code, then to create reproducible, publication-ready tables and charts, each followed by hands-on practice. We close by evaluating AI outputs with a human in the loop. Participants without suitable data can use the demo questionnaire and dataset. Agenda source: the Day 2 schedule on the bootcamp website (_data/bootcamp.yml).
:::
